title: TB Elimination
summary: Partnering with Guam DPHSS to educate and screen residents. 2023 CDC TB Elimination Champions.
details: Together with DPHSS, we integrate TB education and testing into our community outreach. Funded by the AAPCHO TB Elimination Alliance, we have educated over 900 residents and proudly earned the 2023 CDC TB Elimination Champion and Joe T. Ware Partner Service awards.

title: Zero Leprosy
summary: Developing a strategic plan with GPZL to eliminate Hansen’s Disease in Guam.
details: Leprosy (Hansen’s Disease) remains a Neglected Tropical Disease in Guam. By joining the Global Partnership for Zero Leprosy (GPZL) and partnering with DPHSS, we are developing a strategic action plan and roadmap to completely eliminate the disease on our island.

title: Vaccines for All
summary: Providing essential immunizations to eligible children and adults at absolute zero cost.
details: Since becoming a provider for the federally funded Vaccines for Children (VFC) and Adults (VFA) programs in 2023, TGF has provided hundreds of free immunizations. We proudly maintain strict federal compliance to fill healthcare gaps and keep our community protected.
